name: Iterative Algebraic Reconstruction (LSQR)
aliases: 3D Helical Cone-Beam CT Image Reconstruction using LSQR
definition: A 3D volume reconstruction technique that solves the linear system $Ax = b$ using the LSQR iterative solver, where $A$ is the forward projection operator (ray-tracing through a 3D voxel grid) and $b$ is the measured projection data. It uses an adjoint kernel to backproject weighted ray contributions into the volume.
summary: Iterative Algebraic Reconstruction (LSQR) solves 3D helical CT by iteratively minimizing residual error via the adjoint operator, avoiding explicit matrix storage for large sparse systems.
